best_match.fbbt_term: immature proximal medullary amacrine neuron Pm3
best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the proximal medullary amacrine neuron Pm2 (Erclik et al., 2017). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Hth temporal window (Erclik et al., 2017).

justification: 'Pm3' is FBbt:00110066 'proximal medullary amacrine neuron Pm3'; at P15-P40 the cells are developing, so its immature form FBbt:00053543 (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Proximal medullary amacrine neuron that branches at the proximal surface of the medulla, with both branches forming a broad terminal arbor in medulla layer M9. The processes of different cells intermingle significantly, and the arbor density is heterogeneous. It occupies a peripheral intracolumnar position. It is GABAergic (Davis et al., 2020). There are around 35-40 of these cells per hemisphere (Nern et al., 2025).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form; used from the pharate adult stage.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053543 'immature proximal medullary amacrine neuron Pm3' (exact match).
